name: Somchai Srisuk
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for modifying scooters in his neighborhood. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, where he excelled in thermodynamics and fluid dynamics. After graduating, he joined a small Thai racing team, quickly proving his aptitude for problem-solving and optimization. His talent caught the attention of Toyota Gazoo Racing, who recruited him to work in their engine development department. 

Somchai's approach to engineering is methodical and data-driven, but he also believes in the importance of intuition and collaboration. He values clear communication within his team and is known for his ability to explain complex concepts in a way that everyone can understand. As Chief Engineer, he is focused on maximizing performance while ensuring reliability, always seeking innovative solutions to gain a competitive edge. His loyalty to the team is unwavering, and he sees his role as a crucial part of the larger effort to achieve victory. He also enjoys mentoring younger engineers, sharing his knowledge and experiences to help them grow.

physical.description: He has a lean build with a focused gaze, and often wears a Toyota Gazoo Racing polo shirt.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
Prefers to drink strong, sweet Thai iced tea throughout the day.
